title: Synthesize.io
summary: An AI-powered synthetic data generation SaaS platform (Next.js web/admin console plus a FastAPI/Celery API) that lets teams generate privacy-safe synthetic datasets for testing, ML training, and safe data sharing. Its Data Factory service tries to import SDV's single-table synthesizers (GaussianCopula, CTGAN, TVAE, CopulaGAN) as one of several selectable generation backends, run through sdv.single_table and sdv.metadata.
needs: sdv is commented out in apps/api/requirements.txt (Python <3.13 requirement) and the fit/sample call sites are not visible in the harvested code, only class selection; actual execution path unverified.
